07.description: An authenticated government portal calls the assistant API. Role-controlled document operations are exposed by the Document Repository.

09.description: An administrator uploads files from the dashboard and selects Ingest. Dataprep extracts and chunks the content, an embedding model creates vectors, and ArangoDB stores the searchable index.

10.description: The Node.js backend sends the authenticated query to OPEA ChatQnA. Embedding and retrieval can be followed by optional reranking before generation.

11.description: Vector and BM25 rankings are fused. Optional graph traversal expands the candidate set from vector hits.

16.description: OKF combines concept documents and typed relationships into a versioned repository. After publication and ingestion, it can serve as a knowledge graph.

17.description: An illustrative OKF concept graph. Two procedures refer to proof of address; the renewal concept links to public handling notes.

18.description: A draft is curated in OKF Studio. The head can be tested before publication. Publication creates a version and starts ingestion, after which live corpus retrieval can be tested.

19.description: Keycloak supplies claims. GENIE.AI resolves open or closed OKF policy against the serving set, then sends the authorised graphs to retrieval.

24.description: The application uses locally selected file and index stores, then calls configured models. Institution-managed and third-party model endpoints have different data boundaries.

30.description: Docker Compose, Docker Swarm and Kubernetes via Helm can all send model operations to a dedicated HTTPS GPU API. The GPU endpoint serves the configured workloads.

26.description: Instrumented GENIE.AI services send telemetry to the OpenTelemetry Collector. VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs and VictoriaTraces store the corresponding signals. Grafana visualises configured data sources.

14.description: ChatQnA normalises a Kiswahili question to English. Retrieval and generation use the English corpus. The response is translated back to Kiswahili at the edge.
